notes: SFX generated for Sentinel with the ElevenLabs Sound Effects model (eleven_text_to_sound_v2) through the ElevenLabs creative flow API on the account's paid Creator plan (no overage), 1 generation per prompt. Files live in $LIBRARY_STORE/sfx/<name>.mp3 (gitignored). Signed download URLs expire, so only the flow/node/generation ids are kept. 'kind' drives how the mixer aligns a cue: bed (looped), oneshot (onset aligned), whoosh (peak aligned), riser (active end aligned).

ocean_waves.prompt: Gentle open ocean waves lapping against a small boat hull at night, steady, seamless loop

wind_sea.prompt: Steady sea wind blowing over open water, soft low howl, no gusts, seamless loop

jungle_night.prompt: Tropical jungle at night, dense crickets and cicadas chirping, distant frogs, seamless loop

fire_crackle.prompt: Crackling wood fire, distant, occasional pops, seamless loop

rain_storm.prompt: Heavy rain storm at sea, rain pounding on a steel deck, rough waves, seamless loop

helicopter.prompt: Helicopter hovering overhead, loud rotor blades thumping, turbine whine

radio_static.prompt: VHF marine radio static hiss with a sharp squelch click at the start and end

coral_crunch.prompt: Fiberglass boat hull slamming onto a coral reef, heavy deep crunch, cracking and grinding scrape

engine_die.prompt: Small diesel boat engine sputtering, coughing twice and dying to silence

beacon_beep.prompt: Single short electronic emergency beacon beep, high pitched, clean

thunder.prompt: Close thunder clap, sharp crack followed by a deep long rumble

impact_boom.prompt: Deep cinematic boom impact hit, sub bass thump with short tail

whoosh_fast.prompt: Fast short air whoosh swish, transition sound, under half a second

whoosh_low.prompt: Deep heavy low whoosh pass-by, dark and airy, short
